notes:
Extracted the growth-trajectory test on supplied page 6. Coefficient is printed as β; standardization is not explicitly established for this HLM coefficient. No conversion performed. Replication acquisition: DOI landing page did not provide full text; OpenAlex identified publisher/Edinburgh/Westminster routes. Edinburgh and publisher PDF returned 403, Westminster returned 405; no repeated blocked downloads. OSF project file listing contained data ZIP only and no preprints. Elsevier API default response contained metadata only; FULL view required authentication. No replication statistics or narrative verdict inferred from abstracts/search snippets.
Source follow-up: Published eight-page Intelligence 81 (2020), article 101471; supplied title and authors match reference. Rendered publisher PDF p. 5 inspected: the printed negative coefficient, t and p agree with canonical text; canonical ligatures and minus glyphs retained. Input locator p. 6 contains discussion of the target; its primary regression statistics are on p. 5. The 586 subjects minus four explicitly excluded implies 582 remaining participants; Fig. 3 group counts are consistent, but 582 is not explicitly printed as this test analytic n, so n.value is null. No metric conversion. Original side is an unassigned placeholder.
